giver: The Sanctuary keepers: shepherds and leatherworkers in every village bring word of animals in need; Keeper Maren Thistlewood runs the sanctuary at the edge of Reece and gives the key tasks
feel: A sanctuary for rescued and rare animals that grows from a single pen into gardens, a butterfly house and paddocks for unicorns. Gentle, warm, sometimes urgent: animals to find, save, raise and protect.

quests.title: The Stray
quests.summary: A shepherd says a half-starved wolf follows the flock at a distance. Tame it, give it a collar tag and bring it to Maren's pen at the edge of Reece.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a collar tag and bones

quests.title: Pens and Pet Beds
quests.summary: The sanctuary is a single fence. Build proper pens, a shelter and pet beds so rescued animals have a place to rest and respawn.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a pet bed in your choice of colour

quests.title: The Lame Horse
quests.summary: Travellers abandoned a lame horse at their horse campsite. Find the camp, feed the horse back to health with apples and hay, tame it and ride it home slowly.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a saddle

quests.title: Kits at the Hut
quests.summary: A hunter's fox hut has orphaned kits nearby. Win the wary foxes' trust by breeding a pair with sweet berries so the kits are raised trusting you.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a stack of glow berries

quests.title: The Critter Census
quests.summary: Maren keeps a census of the small animals around Reece. Find an otter, a red panda, a ferret and a shima enaga, and tame a ferret to help with the count.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a silk lead

quests.title: Wings in a Bottle
quests.summary: Start the sanctuary's butterfly collection: bottle five different butterflies from Bok's Banging Butterflies across meadows and forests, without harming a single one.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a butterfly banner pattern

quests.title: The Cats of the Ruin
quests.summary: A colony of stray cats lives in a crumbling ruin that creepers have overrun (encounter). Clear the creepers, coax every cat out with fish and bring them home; the old cat-lady of the ruin leaves you her slippers.
quests.reward: Taming XP, Kitty Slippers

quests.title: Lost in the Blizzard
quests.summary: The snowy dog hut's sled team ran off in a blizzard. Track the wolves across the snow, tame each one back and return them to their kennel.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a feather on a stick

quests.title: The Butterfly House
quests.summary: Build a glass butterfly house, raise caterpillars in jars through chrysalis to butterfly, and release them inside among the flowers.
quests.reward: Taming XP, rare butterfly eggs

quests.title: The Koi Pond
quests.summary: A merchant's koi are dying in a stagnant pool. Bucket them, dig a proper pond at the sanctuary with lily pads and clams, and add a dumbo octopus for the visitors.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a pearl necklace

quests.title: A Collar Worth Wearing
quests.summary: Maren shows you how to enchant a collar tag: give your wolf Health Boost and a creeper-sniffing Defusal so it can guard the sanctuary.
quests.reward: Taming XP, enchanted books for pets

quests.title: Eggs to Hatch
quests.summary: A storm flooded the riverbank nests. Collect duck, tortoise and snail eggs before they're lost, hatch them at the sanctuary and keep the young safe until they're grown.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a bug net

quests.title: Shimmering Wings
quests.summary: Tame a dragonfly by the marsh and make it iron armour so it can patrol the sanctuary's pond for pests.
quests.reward: Taming XP, dragonfly wings

quests.title: Lights in the Meadow
quests.summary: Fairies caught by a greedy collector are wilting in jars in his shed. Recover the fairy bottles, and catch a blue, a pink and a gold fairy of your own to release into the sanctuary garden.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a fairy bottle

quests.title: Monkey Business
quests.summary: A capuchin monkey, a raccoon and a crow have been stealing from the market (encounter). Catch them, tame them and turn the thieves into the sanctuary's most popular residents.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a stack of bananas and the stolen goods

quests.title: The Falconer's Glove
quests.summary: Tame a bald eagle, hood it and fly it from a falconry glove; send it out to bring back a rabbit.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a falconry hood

quests.title: The Elephant Caravan
quests.summary: An old trader's elephant is too old to work. Escort the trader and his elephant from the savanna to the sanctuary, where it can retire, riding at its slow pace.
quests.reward: Taming XP, the trader's goods

quests.title: Round Them Up
quests.summary: Lightning spooked the sanctuary's horses and they scattered across the plain (encounters). Ride out and lead every one back to the horse pen before nightfall; the old wrangler gives you his hat.
quests.reward: Taming XP, Cowboy Hat

quests.title: Barding
quests.summary: Make proper armour for the sanctuary's horses: horse helms and armour from Wings, Horns and Hooves, and test a foal's bloodline with the DNA tester.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a slotted horse helm

quests.title: Silver Hoofprints
quests.summary: A shepherd swears she saw a white horse with a horn at dawn. Follow the tracks, gain the unicorn's trust and bring it to the sanctuary.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a talisman

quests.title: A Bond of Spirit
quests.summary: A visiting hedge witch gives Maren a Book of Familiars. Read it and bond a familiar of your own, a companion bound by more than food.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a familiar

quests.title: Wings Over the Paddock
quests.summary: Pegasus feathers keep drifting down onto the sanctuary. Find the winged horse in the mountains, tame it and fly it home.
quests.reward: Taming XP, pegasus feathers

quests.title: Horse of the Sea
quests.summary: Fishermen speak of a horse with a fish's tail playing in their wake. Sail out past the boats at sea, find the hippocamp and ride it back to the sanctuary's sea pen.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a hippocamp saddle blanket (dyed leather horse armour)

quests.title: The Nightmare
quests.summary: In the Nether, piglins have chained a burning nightmare horse in their camp (encounter). Free it, calm it and bring it back through the portal.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a nightmare hoof

quests.title: Wherever You Are
quests.summary: A child's dog was stolen by a passing illager band. Make a wayward lantern from the dog's deed of ownership and follow its glow across the land to bring the dog home.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a deed of ownership

quests.title: Poachers at the Gate
quests.summary: Word of a unicorn has reached the poachers' camp. They come for it at night (encounter): defend the sanctuary with your enchanted pets, then follow them back to their campsite and free the caged animals.
quests.reward: Taming XP, the freed animals and an enchanted book of Herding

quests.title: The Full Herd
quests.summary: Complete the sanctuary's magical herd: add a kirin, a destrier and a reindeer to the unicorn, pegasus, hippocamp and nightmare.
quests.reward: Taming XP, diamond horse armour

quests.title: Pets for the Void
quests.summary: Your companions want to follow you to the End. Enchant their collars with Void Cloud, Tethered Teleport and Fireproof so they come back safe.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a magnet and a stack of chorus fruit

quests.title: Best in Show
quests.summary: The sanctuary hosts a pet show for every village. Enter a companion judged on its enchantments, health, collar and bed, and beat the shepherds' champion sheepdog.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a rosette and an acorn hat

quests.title: The Complete Atlas
quests.summary: Finish the butterfly collection with the rarest wings: the ice butterfly from frozen peaks, the lava from the Nether and the obsidian from the darkest places.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a butterfly golem's favour

quests.title: After the Storm
quests.summary: The great battles have driven animals out of their homes. Find the frightened ones wandering far from home (encounters) and lead them to the sanctuary by land, sea and air with your herd.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a herd of new residents

quests.title: Keeper of the Sanctuary
quests.summary: Maren names you Keeper and gives you the sanctuary's oldest gift, stitched for you.
quests.reward: Taming XP, the Thistlewood Saddle (named enchanted saddle, Unbreaking III and Mending)
